blocks.text: Data cleaning ka matlab hai data ke problems (masle) theek karna ya hatana. Yeh masle ghalat entries, missing values (ghayab qeematein) ya duplicate (do baar aaya hua) data ho sakte hain. Agar yeh ghaltiyan theek na hon to analysis ke results misleading (ghalat raah dikhane wale) honge.

Misal: Ek school students ke grades ka data jama karta hai. Kuch students ne apna naam ghalat likh diya, ya kuch grades record mein nahi hain. Yahan data cleaning ka matlab hai ghalat naam theek karna aur ghayab grades dhoond kar dataset poora (complete) karna. Neeche Table 5.2 (kitab ka text ise “Figure 5.2” kehta hai) yeh process (tareeqa) dikhata hai: ghalat naam, ghayab grade aur duplicate entries jaise aam masle.

blocks.caption: Table 5.2: Grades ke record ki safai. Asal data (ghaltiyon ke saath)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehle table mein “Alie” naam ki spelling ghalat hai aur Sara ka grade khali hai. Saaf table mein naam “Ali” kar diya gaya aur Sara ka grade 75 bhar diya gaya. Kitab yeh nahi batati ke 75 kahan se aaya; asal kaam mein ghayab grade record se dhoond kar likha jata hai (ya topic “Handling Missing Data” ke tareeqe istemal hote hain).

Yeh program record ki safai karta hai: ghalat naam theek karta hai (corrections), duplicate (do baar aayi) line hatata hai aur ghayab grade par nishan lagata hai. records ya corrections badal kar Run karein.

records = [["Ali", 85], ["Alie", 90], ["Sara", None], ["Ali", 85]]
corrections = {"Alie": "Ali"}  # wrong spelling -> right spelling

clean = list()   # cleaned rows go here
for name, grade in records:
    name = corrections.get(name, name)      # fix the name
    if [name, grade] in clean:
        print("Duplicate removed:", name, grade)
        continue
    clean.append([name, grade])

print("Clean data:")
for name, grade in clean:
    print(" ", name, grade if grade is not None else "(grade missing - find it in the record)")

blocks.prompt: Teen problems bataiye jo data cleaning theek karti hai.
blocks.explanation: Ghalat entries (maslan ghalat naam “Alie”), missing values (Sara ka khali grade) aur duplicate records.

items: Data cleaning: ghalat entry theek, ghayab qeemat bharna, duplicate hatana (Alie se Ali, Sara ka grade).
